recipes.name: Chewy No-Bake Peanut Butter Dark Chocolate Oat Bars
instructions: Mix together the flaxseeds and water in a small bowl. Let sit for 5 minutes to gel.
Transfer the flaxseed mixture and all of the other 'blended' ingredients to a food processor. Blend until well combined.
Add in the remaining oats and chocolate, and stir together using a spoon.
Press firmly into a 8 x 12 inch (20 x 30 cm) baking dish.
Place in the fridge for 1 hour to firm. Remove from the fridge, cut, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.
Storage Store in an airtight container on the counter for up to 3 days, or in the fridge for up to 1 week. Keep in the freezer for up to 1 month.
